title: Kagamine Rin — Merry-Go-Round Merriment!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Band me always seems to have so much fun when she's playing. She even got me moving!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She did a great job hyping everyone up, too. What was it she said...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “Everyone! Let's keep raising the roof♪”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds about right!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And the way she talks is so cute.
It's energizing, or maybe infectious is a better word...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I just had a great idea!
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Rin, I didn't realize that you were back.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How was the SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hiya, Miku-P, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: H-Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Miku-P...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you copying the band version of you, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yup! I really like the way she talks.
So, I decided to give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, I know. You two wanna do it with me?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like we don't have much of a choice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Right.
It sounds fun, so let's give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Though we don't really know how that Rin talks, so I don't know if we'll do very well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Not a problem!
Let's just try our best, Miku-P, MEIKO♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, Rin-P, let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'd love it if you also called me Rin-P, MEIKO♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, I can do that.
Oh, if I'm imitating that Rin, then...
You got it, Rin-P! How's that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. That was great!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's keep chatting up a storm like this♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's see... What are you two planning to do later?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Umm... I'm thinking about taking a look at another SEKAI! I wanna see how everyone's doing!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Luka and I are gonna practice our new duet!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll have you guys listen in later, so stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that's why you two have been singing together so much lately!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This is so exciting! I can't wait to hear what you two are gonna sing♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Rin-P, the other day, you and Miku-P...
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, talking has been fun, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are we actually doing this right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I feel like we're all just talking with a little more energy than normal.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm... That's also what I thought.
This is really hard...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I thought you did the best out of all of us, Rin. It must be because you're always watching over that Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?!
Still, though, I feel like I'm missing something...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna go visit that SEKAI again!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll observe that me more closely and really learn how to talk like her!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In that case, I'll go with you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, both of you?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why not? In for a penny, in for a pound.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd also like to see this through until the end. It's probably going to bother me if I don't.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo! Then...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Miku-P, MEIKO!
Let's go visit their SEKAI!
